title: Higher Education Commission Second Amendment Act 2021

sections.shortTitle: Higher Education Commission Second Amendment Act 2021
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PLD 2021 Federal Statutes 577
PLD 2021 Federal Statutes 577
ACT XXII OF 2021
HIGHER EDUCATION COMMISSION
(SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021
An Act further to amend the laws relating to the
Higher Education Commission
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
1st December, 2021]
No.
F. 9(43)/2021-Legis, dated 29.11.2021.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent
of the President on 25th November, 2021 and is hereby published for general information:-
WHEREAS,
it is expedient further to amend the Higher Education Commission Ordinance,
2002 (Ordinance No. LIII of 2002) and the Higher Education Commission
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2021 (Ordinance No. IX of 2021), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act shall be called the Higher Education Commission (Second Amendment) Act,
2021.
(2) It
shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from
the 26th day of March, 2021.
